compute.reported_as: In most simulations, we utilize a CNN similar to the ResNet in Ref. [42,69] with 16 layers (8 residual blocks), kernel size 3x3, channel number C = 32, and in total around 150K parameters. Among 32 channels, 28 of them are transformed into F~vh with N~ = 14 hidden fermions in the studied spinful system, and the remaining channels are used for the generalized Jastrow factor J(n). The symmetry projection explained in Appendix F is also implemented to improve the accuracy. For simulations in III D, we utilize a GCNN [41] as also described in Appendix F. Unless otherwise specified, the total number of samples in each VMC iteration is fixed at N_s = 16384, and the training takes around 10^4 VMC iterations. || arXiv:2507.10705 Sec. II C: "To solve the SR equation, we utilize minimum-norm SR (MinSR) [42] and subsampled projected-increment natural gradient descent (SPRING) [74] with momentum µ = 0.5." || Acknowledgements: "The NQS simulations are performed by Quantax [90], in which the scalable ANNs are implemented by JAX [91] and Equinox [92], and the LRU is implemented by lrux [93]." || quantax (v0.3.1, 81616bf) quantax/operator/operator.py L241-242: "is_valid = ~(jnp.isnan(H_conn) | jnp.isclose(H_conn, 0))" / "segment, conn_idx = jnp.nonzero(is_valid, size=conn_size, fill_value=-1)"
compute.source: Sec. II.C 'Optimization', arXiv:2507.10705 (compute pass 2026-09-16) || arXiv:2507.10705 Sec. II C, Acknowledgements; https://github.com/ChenAo-Phys/quantax/blob/81616bf/quantax/operator/operator.py#L241 (pass 2026-09-27) (compute pass 2026-09-27)
compute.note: Blanket statement for 'most simulations' (all except the stripe-phase runs of Sec. III.D). Parameter count is approximate ('around 150K'); iteration count approximate ('around 10^4'); samples = 16384 per VMC iteration. Optimizer: SR solved with MinSR and SPRING (momentum 0.5). No device or wall-clock is stated for these runs; the only hardware statements are Fig. 3 (forward-pass timing of 10^3 parallel HFPS passes on an A6000 GPU, a benchmark, not a training run) and Table IV (training hours on NVIDIA H100 80GB GPUs for the L x 4 stripe runs only). Software: Quantax (JAX/Equinox), lrux for low-rank updates. || pass 2026-09-27: sr minsr (MinSR / SPRING: the samples x samples kernel). local_energy nonzero: Quantax keeps only non-vanishing connected elements (Pauli-blocked hops dropped), at most 4 N_e hops (verify/agent-C.md G1). reuse left to the family (translation-equivariant CNN, one forward per amplitude: App. F). proposals_per_sample absent: the sampler is not stated (Quantax's default sweep would be 4N if defaults were used, agent-C.md G2). The Pfaffian projection sums (32 on 16x4) run by low-rank updates and are <= 5 % of the forward (agent-C.md).
